resolution.note: supersededByRerun now also covers an unfinished row of a newer Actions run of the head; proved by test/ci/target-checks.test.ts on the verbatim PR 1551 capture (red before, green after)

title: Ship waits on the rerun of a failed required Check instead of the failed attempt
body:
Evidence: PR #1554 lane report 2026-11-20: after a body-only fix and gh run rerun, krn pr ship kept watching the earlier failed Check run on the same head and returned exit 74; an empty commit was needed for a fresh run.
Outcome: ship selects the newest attempt of the required Check on the head (rerun attempts supersede failed ones) and waits on it.
Proof: a ship test from a verbatim gh capture of a rerun (failed attempt 1, in-progress attempt 2 on one head) waits instead of exiting 74.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
